skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the key concepts of agricultural business management, including organizational forms, scientific foundations, management structures, strategies, and labor management.
Apply knowledge to develop business strategies and plans for agricultural enterprises, including land and labor organization.
Enhance self-learning and research skills, as well as presentation and teamwork abilities.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and propose solutions for agricultural business management issues.
Work effectively in teams, contributing to group presentations and discussions.
Improve presentation skills, including structuring reports and delivering effective presentations.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and prepare for presentations.
